            Send an error packet with optional encryption context.
          

          
Parameters

          

            sockfd Socket file descriptor
            

            crypto_ctx Crypto context for encryption (NULL or not ready

            allowlisted error code
          

          
Returns

          

            ASCIICHAT_OK on success, error code otherwise
          

          

            When the crypto context is ready, the packet is encrypted
            automatically. During the handshake (or when encryption is
            disabled), the packet is sent in plaintext so protocol errors can be
            delivered before encryption is active.

627   // Handle encrypted packets
628   if (pkt_type == PACKET_TYPE_ENCRYPTED) {
629     if (!crypto_ctx) {
630       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Received encrypted packet but no crypto context");
631       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
632     }
633
634     // Read encrypted payload
635     uint8_t *ciphertext = buffer_alloc(NULL, pkt_len);
636     if (!ciphertext) {
637       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Failed to allocate buffer for ciphertext");
638       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
639     }
640
641     uint64_t recv_timeout = MAX(timeout_ns, packet_send_timeout_ns(pkt_len));
642     received = recv_with_timeout(sockfd, ciphertext, pkt_len, recv_timeout);
643     if (received != (ssize_t)pkt_len) {
644       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Failed to receive encrypted payload: %zd/%u bytes", received, pkt_len);
645       buffer_release(ciphertext);
646       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
647     }
648
649     // Decrypt - allocate plaintext buffer with extra space
650     // pkt_len is already validated to be <= MAX_PACKET_SIZE, so adding 1024 cannot overflow
651     size_t plaintext_size = (size_t)pkt_len + 1024;
652     uint8_t *plaintext = buffer_alloc(NULL, plaintext_size);
653     if (!plaintext) {
654       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Failed to allocate buffer for plaintext");
655       buffer_release(ciphertext);
656       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
657     }
658
659     size_t plaintext_len;
660     crypto_result_t result = crypto_decrypt(crypto_ctx, ciphertext, pkt_len, plaintext, plaintext_size, &plaintext_len);
661     buffer_release(ciphertext);
662
663     if (result != CRYPTO_OK) {
664       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Failed to decrypt packet: %s", crypto_result_to_string(result));
665       buffer_release(plaintext);
666       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
667     }
668
669     if (plaintext_len < sizeof(packet_header_t)) {
670       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Decrypted packet too small: %zu < %zu", plaintext_len, sizeof(packet_header_t));
671       buffer_release(plaintext);
672       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
673     }
674
675     // Parse decrypted header
676     packet_header_t *decrypted_header = (packet_header_t *)plaintext;
677     if (NET_TO_HOST_U64(decrypted_header->magic) != PACKET_MAGIC) {
678       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Decrypted packet has invalid magic");
679       buffer_release(plaintext);
680       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
681     }
682     pkt_type = NET_TO_HOST_U16(decrypted_header->type);
683
684     // DEBUG: Log decrypted packet type
685     log_debug_every(US_PER_SEC_INT, "[RECV_PKT_DECRYPTED] 🔐 After decryption: actual_type=%u (0x%04x), len=%u",
686                     pkt_type, pkt_type, NET_TO_HOST_U32(decrypted_header->length));
687     pkt_len = NET_TO_HOST_U32(decrypted_header->length);
688     expected_crc = NET_TO_HOST_U32(decrypted_header->crc32);
689
690     // Extract payload
691     size_t payload_len = plaintext_len - sizeof(packet_header_t);
692     if (payload_len != pkt_len) {
693       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Decrypted payload size mismatch: %zu != %u", payload_len, pkt_len);
694       buffer_release(plaintext);
695       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
696     }
697
698     // Verify CRC
699     if (pkt_len > 0) {
700       uint32_t actual_crc = asciichat_crc32(plaintext + sizeof(packet_header_t), pkt_len);
701       if (actual_crc != expected_crc) {
702         SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Decrypted packet CRC mismatch: 0x%x != 0x%x", actual_crc, expected_crc);
703         buffer_release(plaintext);
704         return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
705       }
706     }
707
708     // Set envelope
709     envelope->type = (packet_type_t)pkt_type;
710     envelope->data = plaintext + sizeof(packet_header_t);
711     envelope->len = pkt_len;
712     envelope->allocated_buffer = plaintext;
713     envelope->allocated_size = plaintext_size;
714
715     return PACKET_RECV_SUCCESS;
716   }
717
718   // Handle unencrypted packets
719   if (enforce_encryption && !packet_is_handshake_type(pkt_type)) {
720     SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO, "Received unencrypted packet type %d but encryption is required", pkt_type);
721     return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
722   }
723
724   // Read payload and return header+payload in envelope (matching encrypted path format)
725   size_t total_size = sizeof(packet_header_t) + pkt_len;
726   uint8_t *packet_buf = buffer_alloc(NULL, total_size);
727   if (!packet_buf) {
728     SET_ERRNO(ERROR_MEMORY, "Failed to allocate buffer for packet");
729     return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
730   }
731
732   // Copy header into buffer
733   memcpy(packet_buf, &header, sizeof(packet_header_t));
734
735   if (pkt_len > 0) {
736     uint64_t recv_timeout = packet_send_timeout_ns(pkt_len);
737     received = recv_with_timeout(sockfd, packet_buf + sizeof(packet_header_t), pkt_len, recv_timeout);
738     if (received != (ssize_t)pkt_len) {
739       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK, "Failed to receive payload: %zd/%u bytes", received, pkt_len);
740       buffer_release(packet_buf);
741       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
742     }
743
744     // Verify CRC
745     uint32_t actual_crc = asciichat_crc32(packet_buf + sizeof(packet_header_t), pkt_len);
746     if (actual_crc != expected_crc) {
747       SET_ERRNO(ERROR_NETWORK_PROTOCOL, "Packet CRC mismatch: 0x%x != 0x%x", actual_crc, expected_crc);
748       buffer_release(packet_buf);
749       return PACKET_RECV_ERROR;
750     }
751   }
752
753   envelope->data = packet_buf;
754   envelope->allocated_buffer = packet_buf;
755   envelope->allocated_size = total_size;
756   envelope->type = (packet_type_t)pkt_type;
757   envelope->len = total_size;
758
759   return PACKET_RECV_SUCCESS;
760 }
